personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK fused with 7 Dark-First Utility for dashboard data density
personality_one_liner: A sleek, premium dark-mode experience that feels like a high-end electronics showroom, combining glassmorphic depth with high-contrast utility for EMI tracking.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards use md margin, never flush to edges. Elements inside forms use sm spacing.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar, sticky headers, and featured hero product cards overlay.
Pair blur with a translucent tinted base (≥75% opacity) in dark mode to guarantee readability.
Use glass for premium 'EMI Available' status badges.
dont's: Never blur body text, standard form fields, or standard list rows.
Never rely on blur alone for contrast; always include the dark tint base.

screens.name: Customer Home
screens.purpose: Discover premium electronics and check EMI eligibility instantly.

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner with abstract glass geometric shape fading in/out.
states.error: Readable text with 'Retry Connection' button on a dark charcoal surface.

screens.layout: Hero featured product (e.g., iPhone 15 Pro) with a glassmorphic 'EMI from $49/mo' badge. Below hero, a bento-grid style catalog layout with deep graphite cards and high-contrast photography. Sticky white bottom CTA 'Check EMI Eligibility' if scrolling through a specific promo.

screens.name: Product Detail & EMI Calculator
screens.purpose: View device specs, calculate installment tenures, and proceed to checkout.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for image and typography.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge product image at the top with vertical top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Content underneath includes spec chips (surfaceTertiary) and an interactive EMI calculator bottom sheet (glass header) with segmented controls (3/6/9/12 months) and real-time interest updates. Sticky 'Add to Cart' button.

screens.name: EMI Schedule & Orders (Customer)
screens.purpose: Track upcoming payments and past orders in a single glance.

states.empty: Illustration of a calendar/box with 'No active EMIs'.

screens.layout: Top summary card (brandSecondary / Gold tint) showing 'Next EMI Due' and amount. Below, a timeline list of monthly installments using success (Emerald) for paid, and surfaceTertiary for upcoming. High utility, sharp typography for numbers (Dark-First Utility).

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview of revenue, EMI default risks, and approvals.

states.error: Could not connect to Admin API.

screens.layout: Dense data view. Top row of metric cards (Total Revenue, Active Users). Split panels for 'Pending EMI Approvals' and 'Recent Orders'. Use condensed typography for numeric values to prioritize glanceability.

screens.name: Inventory Manager Dashboard
screens.purpose: Track stock levels, receive low-stock alerts, and restock.
screens.layout: List-heavy utility screen. High-contrast alerts using warning/error tokens for low stock. Quick-action pill buttons 'Restock' directly on the list rows. Clear search and filter sticky row at the top.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '6 Glass / Luxe DARK' personality strictly. Do not use pure black backgrounds; use the provided #0a0a0a obsidian and #151515 secondary surface.
Implement the EMI calculator using a bottom sheet component with glassmorphic styling for the header.

Ensure the EMI Schedule timeline uses sharp, data-first typography (Dark-First Utility fusion) to make numbers highly legible, and use #10b981 (Emerald) specifically for 'Paid' or 'Approved' statuses.
Apply gradient scrims (transparent to #0a0a0a) over all edge-to-edge product images so overlaying white text remains readable.
Buttons should be stark white (brandPrimary) with black text for a minimalist premium feel, rather than using colored CTA buttons.
Build three distinct role-based navigation flows (Customer, Admin, Inventory) separated by authentication state.
